prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait 2:3 illustration to replace a mystery-card placeholder in a dark winter scavenger card-game shop. This is the entire illustrated face of an unidentified sealed supply parcel card, no UI, no typography, no question mark. A single tall rectangular packet of concealed cards wrapped in weathered ivory paper and a deep slate-blue cloth sleeve, closed with two broad charcoal straps and one small round muted brass seal. Three-quarter close view, a slight diagonal, packet occupies 75 percent of the frame, clean readable silhouette. A very narrow warm amber glimmer escapes one fold, suggesting an unknown treasure without revealing the cards. No piles of loot. Background is flat desaturated midnight blue with two broad painterly grey-blue swipes, plentiful quiet negative space, dark corners. Hand-painted anime illustration with clearly shaped matte opaque color masses, connected broad shadows, economical directional blunt brush strokes, occasional handmade overlaps; selective fine lines only at major overlaps. Most paper and cloth surfaces are calm; no uniform noise, no scratch filter, no tiny decorative etching, no photorealism, no shiny 3D render. Simplified materials and strong light-dark grouping matching a rough painted anime card library. NO letters, numbers, words, watermark, ornamental frame, border, UI buttons, people, faces, question mark. Full bleed portrait canvas.
